name: tests-half-jwx-atomic-jwk-edit-transactions
instr:
jwx cannot make atomic key or set changes with detached previews and concurrent-mutation detection. Add optimistic transactions that validate complete replacements and publish them in one revision.

Every successful direct `Set` or `Remove` advances the key revision once. Rejected or ineffective mutations change neither contents nor revision. `Revision(key)` returns the revision and whether it is supported. `BeginEdit` captures one revision. `EditTransaction.Set`, `EditTransaction.Remove`, and `EditTransaction.Preview` use detached state; mutable values cannot alias the source, staged inputs, or previews.

`EditTransaction.Commit` publishes the complete validated state only while that revision remains current. Otherwise return `EditConflictError` with `Expected` and `Actual`. Return `EditValidationError` with `Err` for validation failures, without partial publication. Preserve RSA, EC, OKP, symmetric, and AKP public/private validation and export behavior, including curve or algorithm coherence and secret-byte ownership. Symmetric transactions exclusively own secret material during staging, preview, and publication, and never commit empty key bytes.

Public AKP edits may publish ES256 and four-byte public material together.
